lines.text: Oh come on Cecile. He's crazy about you.
Is it that obvious?
Yes.
He sends me letters you know. Love letters.
That's so romantic. Have you responded?
No.
Well do you like him?
I don’t know.
Hey, how's it going?
Good... any emails today?
Umm, just a couple from your credit card company.
Okay, good.
Hey, you wanna hear a joke?
Yes.
What does a baby computer call its father?
I don't know, what?
Da-ta.
It's good, right?
Oh yeah, brilliant.
Is that what you're going to sing?

No, those are exercises. My coach says you have to do exercise because the vocal cords are muscles and need to be stretched. Every time you stretch them, the middle part gets stronger. That's the place where you sing.
You think I got any kind of a voice?
You sure sing loud!
Is that good?
It's not bad.
Looks like your muscles need a little extra work.
They do not.
Yes, they do. You're out of shape.
What are you talking about? There's no fat on this body!
No fat, but no tone either. You don't get enough exercise.
How were my girls last night?
They were great. We played board games.
"Candyland"?
Of course. It is their favorite.
Well thanks again. I really appreciate you watching them.
Your fingernails are dirty. Your hands are normally so clean.
I've been gardening.
Has it been sunny out today?
Yes. The tulips are loving it.
Are they your favorite flower?
Tulips? Ya, I would say so.
So what do you do?
I’m an entrepreneur.
You mean you’re unemployed?
I wouldn't say that.
What would you say?
That I'm an entrepreneur.
What was your latest preneur?
Well...I founded an internet company that let college kids download and share music for free.
Kind of like Napster?
No, exactly like Napster.
What do you mean?
I founded Napster.
Well, I got up, I ate breakfast and went shopping, and during the afternoon I read a novel.
Which one?
What?
What novel did you read?
I don't remember. Then I fixed supper for the kids.
Hi there.
Hey. What are you up to?
I’m on my way to the library and I might go shopping.
How's Kevin?
Very... Kevin… Anyway, sorry, I gotta catch the bus.
I just have to drop off these set designs -- do you want to go get something to eat?
I can't. Sorry.
Paul, I just can’t go. Is that OK with you or am I committing some horrible crime?
Forget I asked.
I’m sorry. I’m just… I’m so tired lately.
Maybe you ought to see a doctor.
No, it's not like that. It's just I've got those parent conferences, and I'm supposed to set up the math program by next week. And shopping for Ruth's dress and that... that engagement dinner.
You can get out of the dinner.
No, I can't. I've already convinced both Mom and Dad to come.
Come on, Letty. You’ll get through it.
Do you NOT want those never-worn shoes?
Oh -- I completely forgot about --
‘Cause if you don’t -- send them on to me. I’ll squeeze my feet into them.
It's already five o’clock, I need to get going!
Hello? These are never-been-worn four hundred dollar shoes!
I need to go! Bye!
Hey Maureen, I’m sorry this is taking so long.
Don’t worry, it's fine.
I hope you weren't planning on an early lunch.
I'm not really hungry.
Good. I'll check in with you later.
Are you going to finish that?
It's all yours.
Good?
Excellent. What is it?
Cold lamb sandwich with cilantro. A little Coleman's mustard.
Truly - uh - splendid.
Mom can I please go?
Did you ask your mother?
She loves when Jake comes over.
Please, Mom? Please?
Jake I just made dinner.
I'll eat it tomorrow for lunch, I promise.
Okay. But I want you back here in the morning.
Yes! Thanks.
Thank you!
Well, businesses aren't easy--
Actually, I'm in the process of starting a new business.
Good for you. What kind?
Landscape design...

But not like a gardener! I mean, yes, there's a gardening component to it, but the real work is to create unique, eco-friendly outdoor spaces that harmonize with the surrounding environment. Do you know what I mean?
Absolutely.
Hey, so how is the documentary going?
I have a little bit cut together but I haven't touched it in a few weeks.
I'd love to see what you got some time.
You know it's always hard to find balance between a school and a hobby. It's important to prioritize.
Yeah, I can't even prioritize between video games and TV.
I would laugh if that weren't true.
A double espresso and a jelly donut, please.
Same for me.
You mind paying? My credit's no good here anymore, apparently.
Did you go to the employment agency today, Henry?
No, but it's OK. My friend is gonna try to get me a job on the garbage truck.
Did you like the new abstract exhibit?
Ya but that artist…
What?
He's like one of those famous artists, you know? You're excited at first, but the minute you start a conversation, you're begging not to be left alone with the guy.
You talked to him?
Yes, unfortunately...
Good thing I was there to rescue you.
He had some really beautiful pieces though.
What did you have to do with the latest development?
I helped design the camera.
Really? That's impressive. How does it work?
It's designed to photograph in 360 degrees. It scans in the image one line at a time. It takes about five minutes to complete one revolution.
How do you get the images back to earth?
Radio transmission. They figured out a way to interpret the scan lines and then store them digitally.
How long does it take to transmit back to earth?
About ten hours.
Who is the author you’re searching for?
He wrote a children's book called 'The Lion, The Witch and The Wardrobe’.
CS Lewis? That's the author you're talking about?
I guess, though I’m only familiar with that one book.
That book is actually part of a whole series. I used to love reading them.
Really? I’ll have to check out some of the others.
I just had the most extraordinary phone chat with my daughter. She told me that she and her friends are all talking about the British electoral race, which occured today, via their computers.
Your daughter doesn't go to school in the U.S.?
No no. Cambridge. Majoring in French Literature, though I wasn't aware there was such a major.
So you need three hundred dollars?
Well… I just… this will be the last time, I swear.
Of course, I could give you three hundred dollars. But I’m not going to.
What, why?
Gillis, get this through your head. I’m your agent. I want to help you, but I can’t keep giving you money.
I keep reading the first line. It's a good line, I think. But I don't know much about literature.
Maybe you should read the first line of another series of books.
I'm trying to better myself, Caden. Recommend me something. You're a genius; you must've read nearly a dozen books.
I think you should just pick one at random! Then you can’t overthink it.
So, when did you get back?
Tuesday.
I thought you'd go back to New York like Sam and Ingie, and the rest of them.
Oh, I worked there for a couple of vacations, but I don't know... I guess I was homesick.
Homesick? For our small town?
Yes, and my family and... oh, everything.
So, what work do you do?
Real estate. I mean, I went to school for Environmental Studies and I'm still super passionate about that - like understanding our planet and all - but the whole property thing is exploding.
It is important to follow your passion.
I definitely agree. Who knows, maybe I’ll go back to it again one day.
Why Dale, how nice to see you again.
Kirbo, what brings you back here? Nothing serious, I hope.
Oh, no... just tying up some legal loose ends for my friends.
I just have to graduate, so I can go to F.I.D.M. - Fashion Institute of Design, the Hills girls all went there.
Cool, and then intern at Teen Vogue?
Totes...and then have my own line, and fragrance, host a show…
Yeah, I'd like to have my own lifestyle brand.
Definitely.
Good to meet you.
Pleasure to meet you too.
Should we get a couple of sandwiches?
We’ll put it on my tab.
You ever plan on payin' your tab?
I got the winning numbers right here.
What's the jackpot?
Twelve million.
I don't think that'll cover it.
Hey you two, I told you to stop playing games and do your chores.
But mom, it's summer break!
So?
And dad said it was okay.
We have a rule in this house
But during vacation we have all this free time. We can do our chores later!
I’m not going to tell you again.
Are you gonna have a boy or a girl?
I don't know yet.
When will you know?
Not until summertime. You guys will probably be on vacation.
If you have a boy what will you name him?
Maybe...Woodrow?
That's a name for a man -- not a baby!
So I have to? I just stopped working at a supermarket two weeks ago. I'm trying to create some financial stability for myself. The first time I make any real money, I can't just give it to her.
Well that's very selfish.
Well you guys went on a cruise last year. Maybe you shouldn't have gone, and saved for her college education instead.
Oh, so after all we've done for you, we can't enjoy ourselves? We should never take a vacation?
I had to drop out of college after two years because you couldn't pay for it. Now I have to pay for hers? Let her figure it out. Let her get a job.
I didn't realize I raised such a selfish boy. When I was young I would have done anything for my family.
Paul, is that yours?
Yeah. You like motorcycles?
Of course. Who doesn't?
Well for one, my mom doesn't. She's kind of anti-motorcycle...
That's too bad. They're fun.
Vanderholt.
Grace. I ran Mrs. Asher's DNA against the victim's down here. No way he's her son.
Not her son? You’re sure?
Lab ran the test twice.
That's weird. Was he adopted, switched at birth?
Listen for a minute. There was a match. It's not Mrs. Asher, but we have a lead.
I called about your transcripts. You're all set. Patterson's got a pretty good Humanities program. No ballet, but we can find a studio someplace close for --
I don't think I'll have time. I have to study, I'll be busy.
Good idea. Take a break, but not too long though. You're a dancer an you should dance. Stay on top of your art.
Like you stay on top of yours?
Maybe I’m not playin’ for any grand ballrooms or fancy jazz festivals, but I'm playing.
I didn't mean it like that.
I have someone I want you to meet.
I don't want to meet anyone.
You'll like her.
Uh-huh. Does she like jazz?
Probably not.
Then what are we gonna talk about?
You'll talk about the weather.
Ok. Then I have someone I'd like you to meet. He's got a face tattoo, but a heart of gold.
I heard you had an accident.
Ya, cut my hand on a drawer handle. When are we going to get some new furniture ‘round here?
I'll have a word with Tod. We'll make it a priority on the top floor.
Thanks, I’d appreciate that greatly.
Anyway, where are you off to?
Lunch.
Want some company?
Sure.
I’ll take three tickets please.
No problem, sir. Just give me one moment.
By the way, when is Earth, Wind and Fire coming to town?
I'm really not sure. I haven't heard anything yet, but you can check our website for updates.
Will do. I’m planning to take my little brother.
Excellent. I hope to enjoy the show.
How do you think you're going to make a living?
I can fix cars.
You can fix old cars. Mr. Washburn told me that the cars they're making now are all computerized--
You think I can’t learn that?
I think you can learn whatever you want to. I just don't see you doing it. If you want to settle for--
I'm not settling for anything. I like cars. Just because I’m not moving up some corporate ladder, you think it's a waste.
That isn’t true.
Mr. Panos, I've charted the growth of new office space in the city, and I think you're in the right business at the right time.
Thank you for telling me what I already know.
I'm impressed with your work and I could use a tax break. This is a growing business. Are you interested in some working capital and a partner?
What makes you think I need a partner?!
So do you like your new room?
It's interesting.
Your Dad spent all his spare time in here. He wanted to make it absolutely perfect.
I can tell. I really think it looks amazing.
Donna?
I need to talk to Linda. Where is she?
I don't know. I haven't talked to her all day. Call her cell phone.
I tried. Look, you have to know where she is. Just tell me.
I was just about to get some work done. I really don’t have time --
Paul. Please, I really need to see her.
Have your tuberculosis symptoms changed at all in the past week?
Yeah, I feel a bit better now. I've been able to go to the gym and eat out the past couple days.
You’re still highly contagious. Do you understand?
Yes.
You need to stay away from other people until your symptoms improve.
One of my patients is infected with tuberculosis and has been in contact with a number of other people. His name is Andy Simmons. Here is his contact information.
Thank you for the information. I'll reach out to him.
What did you do? You broke it!
I’m sorry, it was an acc-
I don’t want to hear it!
But mama I didn’t mean to!
I’ve had enough of you today! Go to your room… now!
Hi honey, how was dinner?
Well… I’m a little concerned about how Lavern treated Misty tonight… she accidentally broke during dinner and Lavern really yelled at her… Do you think I should say something to her?
Hey babe. How was work?
I had a really tough day. One of my clients had an emergency and I thought I might have to stay late..
Oh my God... what happened? You said it was going to be a slow night.
That's what I thought, but I was wrong.
Do you want to talk about it?
Sorry honey, you know I can’t. Doctor patient confidentiality and all.
I think I’ll just sneak out before my parent's get home… ya I’m sure they won’t even notice. Okay see you at the party!
Hey buddy, have you seen your sister?
Uhh… sorry what's up?
Have you seen Barbara? I think she might have stayed late at school, but she didn’t say.
Oh… ya I haven’t seen her… sorry!
Thanks for the gifts mom! These are great!
Of course sweety! I’m glad you like them.
You know, I remember the cutest thing from when Welles was little. I was volunteering for a field trip at Welle's school-
Not again...
Welle's teacher was handing out passes for the trip and Welles said “Thanks mom”. It was funny, but so cute.
Dude that's hilarious!
Mom, please! You’re embarrassing me in front of my friend!
Hey Ike, how are you doing?
Ah, you know, I’ve just been having some problems.
Everybody's got some, I guess.
Ya, but you and Janey don’t seem to be having the problems Kate and I do…
Oh, I didn’t realize you two aren't getting along.
Ya, we do our best to not let it show…
So I ran into Ike earlier and he said he and Kate aren’t doing so well.
Oh… I had no idea. Did he say why?
Nope, he didn’t mention it. It seems like he doesn’t really want anyone else to know.
Hi, this is Jay.
Hi Jay, this is Doctor Virgil speaking.
Hey Doc, we’re just finishing up with dinner. Any news on the blood tests?
Actually, now might not be a good time. I’ll just call back tomorrow.
Phew, you had me a bit worried. I’ll wait for your call tomorrow.
How was school, you two?
It was okay. I think I did well on my test.
Fine.
Is something wrong honey?
I’m fine.
Did something happen?
Uh… I don’t think so.
What's up with your work Holly? You used to be so enthusiastic, but now you seem a bit out of it.
You know, it's probably my fault. I've been a little depressed lately.
Holly's performance is not as good as last year... What's the problem?
It's my fault, I should have noticed. She's just been feeling depressed. I'll talk to her about it.
The court calls Ms. Cynthia Webb.
Raise your right hand. Do you swear to tell the truth, the whole truth and nothing but the truth so help you God?
Yes.
You may be seated.
I know her.
You must recognize her name from the court briefing.
No. I mean I know her personally.
Please state your name for the court.
Cynthia Webb.
Do you recognize the man sitting before you?
No.
Do you mean to tell me that before today you have never seen Mr. William McCall?
That's correct.
Okay, can you please drop him off tomorrow morning?... He can visit with you on the weekends, but I have custody during the week… I don’t have money for a sitter right now… Okay fine, bye.
Hi Sharyl, I wanted to speak with you about something for a moment.
Yes, of course.
Well, I've noticed Brett's work has been lacking lately, and he's had more frequent absences. Do you know if there's something wrong?
No I haven’t really noticed anything.
Okay, thank you, I’ll check in with him tomorrow.
Oh, I’m so proud of your boy.
Yeah, we all are. We’re treating him to a trip to Hawaii.
That's delightful!
Congratulations, Alex! We’re so proud of you!
Thanks, nana! It's a relief to have made it through the semester…
Well now you’ll have plenty of time to relax during your big trip!
What big trip?
Your dad told me that you’re going to Hawaii to celebrate. Did the trip get cancelled?
Woah! No way!
Hellen, we hadn’t told him yet...
Kate, what are you doing? You're 20 minutes late!
I'm sorry...
This is absolutely unacceptable. This is the third time you've been late this week.
I’m really sorry Kate. My mother needed my help. She's going through chemotherapy.
I'm very sorry to hear that... Please just notify me in advance next time.
The mortgage and utilities are paid for the month, and we still have quite a bit leftover.
That's great honey.
How much does a house cost?
Well ours is worth about $400,000, but it wasn’t worth that when we bought it. Why do you ask sweety?
One of my friends asked at school. He thinks we’re rich.
Don’t worry about that sweety. Our finances are a family matter, and it's much better to show modesty than to brag about what we have.
Wow, is that a new tablet? I always wanted one.
Yup.
You must be rich! You always have the best stuff…
I don’t think we’re rich, I just needed it for school.
Hi Dr. Calla, how are you doing today?
Not too bad. I just finished meeting with Mr. Walton to discuss his procedure. This is his son, Andy.
Hello Andy, nice to meet you.
So have you gone over Mr. Walton's test results with him yet? I know he's been anxious to hear.
I think it would be best if we wait to talk about this with Mr. Walton
Oh… yes of course.
Hey dad, what did you want to talk about?

I’m concerned about your grades, Andrew... Your report card came in the mail and you’re failing one of your classes. I think you’ve been focusing a bit too much on your friends and not enough on your grades.
I just don’t want to. I’d rather hangout with my friends. Mom says I can.
We both want you to be able to spend time with them, but your grades come first.
